coordinated_activities.activity: Boiling water in the kettle, toasting bread, and eating breakfast
Changing into work clothes, checking the phone, and packing the work bag
Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
Working clinical duties and caring for patients
Taking a lunch break at work
Continuing clinical duties, charting, and handing over patient notes
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV, running the fan instead of the air conditioner to avoid the evening peak air-conditioner tax
Using the computer for continuing education modules and personal admin
Preparing lunch for the next shift and tidying the kitchen
